title: Two attempts to fix the position gain by reward shaping, both backfire
question: Run 18 measured the policy wandering 1.9x further than classical, and the verifier flagged the same axis. Can reward shaping close it?
headline: No, and it goes the wrong way. Pressing harder on position made the position gain SMALLER by two independent mechanisms — 0.35 to 0.08 to 0.03 — while survival collapsed from 100% to 13% to 0%. This is a sim-only result; nothing was deployed.
